fields.description: Issue includes editorials and commentary criticizing Miami Beach vagrancy enforcement and broader civil-liberties concerns; a prominent attack on publisher John S. Knight and discussion of U.S. Senate politics involving Claude Pepper. Reports cover local law enforcement practices (including a detailed police report on the Lenox Hotel raid and discussion of entrapment tactics), gambling/bookmaking enforcement, and automobile break-ins. Additional local civic coverage includes opposition to siting a fire station on a school playground near Allapattah School, along with business and economic notes and regular columns/letters.
